acc.text:
This is follow-up round 2 (S7). Round 1 reviewed every reason of 203 items in 23 briefs; the lead applied 77 reason changes, restored two First step bands to the live grouping (toxidrome band 1, ipv band 0: a pairing left one order heading no result) and closed the other findings with reasons. Each brief's section in your packet files has: "Lead decisions on round 1" (every fix, old and new wording and the finding it answers; every finding closed without a change and why), then "Changed items as they now read". Scope: (1) every changed reason and changed band, judged by your part's rules in the item's context; (2) each round-1 finding of your part: resolved, or still open (say why); a closed finding stays closed unless the new text makes it wrong in a new way. Reasons that did not change are out of scope.
Calls: read INSTRUCTIONS.md (done), then each packet file once in order, then write the lane receipt ONCE at the end. Never use Glob or list folders; never write an interim receipt; every extra call comes out of the reads you need.
Part acc: each changed reason is correct for Step 2 CK and true for its stem (the key's reason gives what makes the key right here; a distractor's reason gives that choice's defining feature or the stem fact that rules it out); agrees with the brief, the item explanation and the cited claims and keeps their hedges; adds no fact they do not support. A reason that would teach a wrong rule is HIGH; unsupported or contradicting the brief MED; wording LOW with a replacement. The board cards cited for bs-learning (no folder) are AnKing cards named in the decisions.
Call plan: %(plan)s.
%(extra)sIn the receipt, each brief's section adds `Earlier findings` (each acc finding of round 1 for that brief: resolved, closed, or open with the reason) before `Findings` (new ones). A PASS-IF replacement's old text is a reason copied exactly from the packet; new text 3 to 14 words, no dashes, arrows, ampersands or markup.
acc.plan: 1 Read per packet file, in order, then 1 Write of the lane receipt

Toxidrome "Salicylate level" heading no result (MED): ACCEPTED: toxidrome band 1 and ipv band 0 are restored to the live grouping (all orders on top, results below), because a pairing left one order heading no result. The reason text changes do not change how reasons render.
Images in your lane root: bands_phone_sheet1.png, bands_phone-study_sheet1.png, bands_desktop_sheet1.png: the First step panels of toxidrome and ipv at 390 px phone, phone in study mode, and 1280 desktop.
